name: Lacerda Insurance Agency
what_they_do: Independent insurance agency writing personal auto, commercial auto, homeowners, renters, general liability and workers' compensation, and representing carriers such as Progressive, Foremost, Liberty Mutual, Home-Choice, Bristol West, Hiscox, Am-Guard and Travelers. Also does in-person walk-in business in a bilingual community.
customers: Individual drivers and homeowners plus small business owners (contractors, employers needing workers' comp and general liability), concentrated in New Brunswick's Latino/Portuguese-speaking community.

size_signals.signal: Site states 'over 15 years of industry experience' and describes a team of agents ('our agents will advise you…')
Single Livingston Avenue storefront with parking lot and walk-in service; long hours Mon-Fri 9-7, Sat 9-2
Represents a dozen-plus carriers across personal and commercial lines - inference: a small independent agency (roughly 2-5 staff) with appointment/quoting rights for multiple insurers

listing.platform: Third-party directory snapshot of Google listing (localitybiz) - Google not viewed directly

website_review.primary_cta: 'Get A quote!!' linking to a single auto-quote form
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: One auto-insurance quote form (21 fields including date of birth, licence number and VIN); everything else is by phone, email or walk-in
website_review.trust_signals: 15+ years, named carrier partners, a customer testimonial with five stars on the homepage, photos, FAQ block covering parking/documents/turnaround; no staff names or photos
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Footer credit 'Wonder - A WordPress Block theme by YITH'; URLs contain an odd install path (/website_c1d19621/); no copyright year shown; homepage has no meta description
website_review.search_basics: Title is just the agency name twice ('LACERDA INSURANCE - LACERDA INSURANCE AGENCY') with no service or town; no meta description; only WebPage JSON-LD - no InsuranceAgency/LocalBusiness schema, no hours or services marked up; individual coverage sections are on one page rather than their own pages
top_issues: No click-to-call: the phone number never appears as a tel: link, so a phone visitor ready to buy auto insurance cannot tap to call from the site.

The only online quote path is an auto-only 21-field form asking for licence number, date of birth and VIN; homeowners, general liability and workers' comp prospects are told to call, email or come in person (FAQ admits home/commercial quotes take 2-4 business days).
No LocalBusiness/InsuranceAgency structured data and no town or service in the title/description, so search and AI assistants cannot confidently answer 'who insures X in New Brunswick' from the site.

agent_readiness.notes: robots.txt could not be read (server returned HTTP 406 to a non-browser client), so crawler rules are unverified. Hours, address, services and carrier partners are readable text, and an FAQ answers common questions - good for answerability. But schema is WebPage only (no InsuranceAgency/LocalBusiness) and there is no booking, only a quote form.

operations_signals.signal: FAQ tells customers to email documents and that a home or commercial quote 'can take up to 2-4 business days' because underwriters must respond - inference: slow manual quote turnaround that a follow-up agent could shorten by chasing documents.
FAQs about parking, EV charging and what to bring for a quote suggest a walk-in-heavy, in-person workflow where staff handle each transaction manually.
Only 15 public reviews after 15+ years - inference: no systematic review requests.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Build proper quote intake for every line (auto, home, renters, GL, workers' comp) with short stepped forms, document upload for licence/VIN, and instant acknowledgement plus follow-up until underwriter pricing arrives.
top_opportunities.evidence: Only an auto-only 21-field form exists; FAQ says other quotes require calling, emailing or visiting, with 2-4 business days for home/commercial.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add click-to-call and WhatsApp/messaging intake plus an AI assistant that answers 'how much for X', collects driver/vehicle/business details and books a quote appointment.
top_opportunities.evidence: No tel: links anywhere; the audience is bilingual walk-in/phone-first and there is no chat or booking on the site.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add InsuranceAgency JSON-LD (address, hours, services, carrier list, area served) and rewrite titles/descriptions around 'auto & commercial insurance New Brunswick NJ'.
top_opportunities.evidence: Only WebPage schema; title repeats the agency name and the homepage has no meta description.

scores.reasons: Missing click-to-call, single-line quote intake and no local schema on a five-star agency is a real gap, and fixes are cheap; an independent agency's revenue depends on commission volume, so budget is moderate.
